integrity: Analytical proof supplies all infinite quantifiers; 24,257 finite verification assertions are supplementary and do not constitute an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The bound is one-sided, with a potentially nonoptimal logarithmic factor and numerical coefficient. It holds for Bernoulli ±1 increments, payoff within one lattice unit, and the threshold at drawdown one, and does not determine the sharp asymptotic of the critical probabilities. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: An effective logarithmic rate for the critical probabilities of stopping near a random-walk maximum
